title: HorsePower Brands Fuels Franchise Growth With MNTN
summary: With intuitive multi-account management and detailed reporting suite, MNTN gave HorsePower Brands the tools to run a coordinated national CTV strategy — and prove its impact across every franchise.
body_markdown:
**Drive awareness:** Build brand recognition ahead of peak spring and summer demand so their businesses would be top of mind when homeowners needed service.


**Simplify TV advertising:** Enable their lean team to manage nine brands through a self-serve platform that removes the complexity of traditional TV buying.


**Stand out from competitors:** Establish a presence on premium networks like HBO Max, ESPN, NBC, and Fox to differentiate themselves in a crowded home improvement space.
